verdict.rationale: Docusign's generic e-signature tooling can handle the mechanics of this story: reusable, shareable templates to standardize documents, configurable workflows, delegated signing, identity verification, and the ability to send, sign and approve documents online. Nothing in the evidence addresses board consents or resolutions specifically, so a legal-ops lead would have to build these flows from general-purpose agreement templates. Missing for 10: board consent/resolution templates, board-specific approval tracking (e.g., unanimous written consent or quorum status), governance or equity-fundraising workflow features, and independent or hands-on corroboration for this use case.
